description: The file contains C source code with functions to parse various data types (signed, unsigned, int, long, double, bool, environment variables) with specific focus on Git-related parsing utilities. It includes implementations for parsing numeric values with unit suffixes and boolean values, as well as environment variable handling.

methods.name: uintmax_t get_unit_factor(const char * end)
methods.description: Determines the multiplier based on unit suffix ('k', 'm', 'g') in the input string.

methods.name: int git_parse_signed(const char * value,intmax_t * ret,intmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses a string as a signed integer with optional unit suffix, enforcing a maximum value.

methods.name: int git_parse_unsigned(const char * value,uintmax_t * ret,uintmax_t max)
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned integer with optional unit suffix, enforcing a maximum value.

methods.name: int git_parse_int(const char * value,int * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as an int using git_parse_signed.

methods.name: int git_parse_int64(const char * value,int64_t * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as an int64_t using git_parse_signed.

methods.name: int git_parse_ulong(const char * value,unsigned long * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as an unsigned long using git_parse_unsigned.

methods.name: int git_parse_ssize_t(const char * value,ssize_t * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as an ssize_t using git_parse_signed.

methods.name: int git_parse_double(const char * value,double * ret)
methods.description: Parses a string as a double value, supporting unit suffixes.

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool_text(const char * value)
methods.description: Converts certain string literals to boolean-like integers (true/false).

methods.name: int git_parse_maybe_bool(const char * value)
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a boolean value, including numeric conversion.

methods.name: int git_env_bool(const char * k,int def)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable as a boolean, with a default fallback.

methods.name: unsigned long git_env_ulong(const char * k,unsigned long val)
methods.description: Reads an environment variable as an unsigned long with optional parsing fallback.

ctags.name: git_env_ulong
ctags.pattern: /^unsigned long git_env_ulong(const char *k, unsigned long val)$/
